attributes.name: Stalker's Crossbow
attributes.powers:
If this card has the Corrupted trait, discard the top card of your deck or you may not play this card.

For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+4. If you would fail this check, you may discard this card to reroll the dice, adding another 1d8; take the new result.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add another 1d4+2 to a combat check by a character at another location.
